data.title: 守岸人 · 黑海岸的潮起
data.description: 黎明的黑海岸，她赤足站在浅滩上，头纱与蓝色长发被海风托起；掌心悬浮的发光蝴蝶照亮她的侧脸——五千年的守望从每天第一个潮起开始。
data.action: 黎明的黑海岸，她赤足站在浅滩上，头纱与蓝色长发被海风托起
data.promptProse: At Black Shores dawn, the Shorekeeper stands barefoot in shallow water, a glowing butterfly hovering above her open palm. Blue hair and the light veil lift in the sea wind beside the white ankle-length dress and embroidered outer layers. The medium portrait includes the first tide line and distant shore. Dawn light brightens water edges and skirt folds, while the butterfly adds a small concentrated glow to her fingers and near cheek.
